= Font icons
:icons: font

With `icons=font`, admonitions show their kind's icon in place of the label, and inline icons
are Font Awesome's.

NOTE: A note, written as a paragraph.

TIP: A tip with an icon:lightbulb[] icon inline.

[IMPORTANT]
====
An important block.

With two paragraphs.
====

.A titled caution
[CAUTION]
====
A caution with a title.
====

[WARNING]
A warning in a paragraph block.

An icon:heart[] and an icon:info-circle[] in a paragraph.
